deny.title: Deny {{ip}}?
deny.descriptionOn: Sign-ins and session renewals from {{ip}} are refused from now on, for everyone in this organisation. A session opened from it ends at its next renewal.
deny.descriptionOff: It's added to IP rules as a deny rule. Nothing is refused yet: IP rules are off. Once they're on, sign-ins and session renewals from {{ip}} are refused.
deny.label: Denied from {{what}}

anomalies.title: Anomalies
anomalies.description: Sign-in attacks the lockout detected and slowed. Resolve each one once you've dealt with it.

line.accounts_one: Failed sign-ins against {{count}} account from one network
line.accounts_other: Failed sign-ins against {{count}} accounts from one network
line.accountsIn_one: Failed sign-ins against {{count}} account from one network in {{minutes}} minutes
line.accountsIn_other: Failed sign-ins against {{count}} accounts from one network in {{minutes}} minutes
line.oneNetworkIn_one: {{count}} failed sign-in from one network in {{minutes}} minutes
line.oneNetworkIn_other: {{count}} failed sign-ins from one network in {{minutes}} minutes

band.highToday: {{n}} high severity in the last 24 hours
band.chartLabel: {{n}} detected in the last {{days}} days, a day at a time

empty.title: No sign-in attacks detected
empty.description: When the lockout slows repeated failed sign-ins, it shows here.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another account or address, or clear the filters.

drawer.lockedUntil: Qeet ID locked password sign-in for the account from that network until {{when}}.
drawer.lockedEnded: Qeet ID locked password sign-in for the account from that network until {{when}}. The lock has ended.
drawer.throttledUntil: Qeet ID refused password sign-in from that network until {{when}}.
drawer.throttledEnded: Qeet ID refused password sign-in from that network until {{when}}. That has ended.
drawer.botHits_one: {{count}} scored sign-in from this address, {{blocked}} would block
drawer.botHits_other: {{count}} scored sign-ins from this address, {{blocked}} would block
drawer.noBotHits: None in the last 50 scored sign-ins
drawer.deniedOff: The deny rule {{cidr}} covers it, but IP rules are off
drawer.noRuleOff: No deny rule covers it, and IP rules are off
drawer.denyOn: Add {{ip}} as a deny rule: its sign-ins and session renewals are refused at once.
drawer.denyOff: Add {{ip}} as a deny rule. It refuses sign-ins once IP rules are turned on.
drawer.checkLine: See whether anyone got in: its sessions and recent sign-ins.
drawer.twoStepLine: A guessed password alone won't get in.
drawer.resolveNote: Resolving marks it dealt with. It doesn't lift a lock or change anything for the account.

bots.title: Bots
bots.description: Each password sign-in's client is scored from its user agent. Nothing is refused: a verdict says what would happen.

band.wouldBlockNote: Scored {{threshold}} or more. Nothing was refused.
band.hoursLabel: Sign-ins that would be blocked, an hour at a time, over the last 24 hours

empty.title: No automated clients
empty.description: A sign-in from a script or an app that isn't a browser shows here.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another address or client, or clear the filters.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: A sign-in's client is scored from 0, a browser, to 1, a script. Sign-ins scoring under 0.30 aren't kept.
detection.onHint: Each password sign-in is scored and the verdict kept
detection.offHint: Sign-ins aren't scored, and nothing is added to the list
detection.atScore: At a score of {{threshold}} or more

ipRules.title: IP rules
ipRules.description: Which addresses may sign in to this organisation.

enforce.title: Enforcement
enforce.description: While on, every sign-in and session renewal is checked, and an address that can't be read is refused. A change that would refuse your own address isn't saved.
enforce.label: Enforce rules
enforce.onDescription: From now, sign-ins and session renewals from addresses the rules refuse are stopped, for everyone in this organisation. {{allow}} allow rules and {{deny}} deny rules apply.
enforce.offDescription: Every address can sign in and renew sessions again. The rules are kept, unused, until you turn them back on.

check.label: Check an address
check.unknown: It isn't an address the rules can read.
check.whileOff: Judged against the rules as they stand; nothing is refused while they're off.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: A deny rule always wins. Once any allow rule exists, an address must match one.
rules.emptyDescription: Every address can sign in. Add an allow rule for your offices, or a deny rule for an address that's attacking you.

add.title: Add a rule
add.rangeHint: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a range in CIDR form.
add.label: Label
add.allowHint: Once any allow rule exists, an address outside every allow rule is refused.
add.denyHint: Refuses the range, whatever the allow rules say.
add.invalid: Enter an IP address or a CIDR range, such as 203.0.113.0/24.
add.confirmDeny: IP rules are on: sign-ins and session renewals from {{cidr}} are refused from now on.
add.confirmAllow: IP rules are on: {{cidr}} can sign in from now on.
add.confirmFirstAllow: IP rules are on, and this is the first allow rule: from now on only {{cidr}} can sign in, and sessions from anywhere else end at their next renewal.

remove.label: Remove the rule for {{cidr}}
remove.title: Remove the rule for {{cidr}}?
remove.descriptionOff: The rule is deleted. Nothing changes for anyone now: IP rules are off.
remove.descriptionDeny: {{cidr}} can sign in again at once.
remove.descriptionAllow: Addresses only this rule allowed are refused at their next sign-in or session renewal.
remove.descriptionLastAllow: It's the last allow rule, so every address not denied can sign in again.

refusals.title: Refused sign-ins
refusals.description: The latest 20 sign-ins and session renewals the rules refused.
refusals.unknown: An address that couldn't be read
refusals.emptyDescription: No sign-in has been refused by these rules.

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: Each sign-in that passes its password gets a risk score. A risky one must pass two-step verification, even on a remembered device; someone without a second factor confirms a code sent to their email.

levels.title: Risk levels
levels.description: Where medium and high start, and which level must pass two-step verification.
levels.mustPass: Must pass two-step verification, even on a remembered device
levels.askHighHint: Clearly automated, or several signals at once.
levels.askMediumHint: Also less certain ones, so more people are asked.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: What adds up to a sign-in's score, at most 1. An app that isn't a browser on a new device scores {{app}} + {{device}} = {{sum}}: {{level}}.
signals.clientLine: 0 to 1 from the user agent: 0.95 for a script or headless browser, 0.90 with no user agent, 0.55 for an app that isn't a browser.
signals.travelLine: Adds {{n}} for a new country within {{hours}} hours of the last sign-in. It needs the country from your proxy; without it, this adds nothing.
signals.hoursHint: Of the last sign-in. At least {{min}}.
signals.deviceLine: Adds {{n}} for a browser and system the person hasn't signed in from before.

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.description: How many requests Qeet ID takes before it answers “Too many requests”. Each limit holds a burst and refills at its rate.

yours.title: Your organisation
yours.description: On every signed-in request. You can lower these, not raise them: the platform's are the most allowed.

tenant.label: Organisation
tenant.hint: All signed-in requests in this organisation, from people, applications and keys

user.label: Each person
user.hint: One person's requests, across their sessions

reset.title: Use the platform's limits?
reset.description: Your organisation, each person and each API key go back to the platform's limits, the most allowed. Requests your lower limits refused are taken again, at once.

builtIn.title: Built-in limits
builtIn.description: Set by the platform for every organisation, against password guessing and floods. An address is an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /64 network.

signIn.label: Sign-in
signIn.hint: Per address: signing in and up, account recovery, invitations, and the sign-in page's other steps

directory.label: Directory sign-in
directory.hint: Per address: signing in with an LDAP directory's password

codes.label: Codes
codes.hint: Per person: sending a verification code, and changing a password

pairing.label: Phone pairing
pairing.hint: Per address: linking a phone with a pairing code

links.label: Sign-in links and resets
links.hint: Per email address, for sign-in links and password resets; sign-in links also 10 per caller, then 1 a minute

tokens.label: Tokens
tokens.hint: Per address: the token endpoint, which an application calls for everyone who signs in to it

protocols.label: Protocols
protocols.hint: Per address: OpenID Connect discovery and keys, SAML and SCIM

logStreams.title: Log streams
logStreams.description: Sends this organisation's audit events to your SIEM as they happen.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Each one gets every new event, at least once.
destinations.emptyDescription: Stream the audit log to Splunk, Datadog or any HTTPS endpoint, so your security team sees it with everything else.

splunk_hec.name: Splunk HEC
splunk_hec.line: HTTP Event Collector. The token is sent as “Splunk <token>”.

datadog.name: Datadog
datadog.line: Logs intake. The API key is sent as DD-API-KEY.

http.name: Generic HTTP
http.line: Any HTTPS endpoint. A token, if any, is sent as a Bearer token.

failing.title: Can't deliver to {{host}}
failing.retry: Qeet ID keeps the events and tries again, waiting longer each time, up to an hour; they're sent once it works. Check the endpoint with whoever runs it:

logStreams.pausedNote: Paused: nothing is sent. The events wait, and resuming sends everything since.

remove.label: Remove {{host}}
remove.title: Remove {{host}}?
remove.description: Qeet ID stops sending events to {{host}}. Adding it again starts from then: the events in between aren't sent.

add.title: Add a destination
add.description: It gets every audit event from now on; earlier events aren't sent.
add.endpointInvalid: Enter an HTTPS address, such as https://logs.example.com/qeet-id.
add.tokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

sent.title: What's sent
sent.eventsValue: Every audit event from when a destination is added. Earlier events aren't sent.
sent.deliveryValue: Every 10 seconds, up to 100 events at a time
sent.deliveryHint: A batch that fails is sent again until the destination takes it.
sent.formatHint: Splunk HEC gets one envelope per event; Datadog a list of log entries; Generic HTTP an object with a list of events.
sent.sample: An event, as Generic HTTP receives it

devices.title: Device sign-ins
devices.description: Sign-ins from devices without a browser, such as a command-line tool: the device shows a code, and someone approves it on another screen. A code lasts 10 minutes.

outcome.approved: Approved; the device collects its sign-in on its next check
outcome.denied: Refused, so the device got nothing

deny.title: Deny code {{code}}?
deny.description: The device showing {{code}} for {{app}} gets no access, and the code can no longer be approved.

actions.events: The approver's events in the audit log

band.chartLabel: {{n}} requested in the last {{days}} days, a day at a time

empty.title: No device sign-ins
empty.description: When a device without a browser asks to sign in, its code shows here.
empty.waitingDescription: A request shows here while its code is live, for 10 minutes.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another code or email, or show every status.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change and sign-in in this organisation, each chained by its hash to the one before, so an edit or a deletion shows.

actions.sameKind: Events on this kind of resource

empty.title: No events yet
empty.description: Sign-ins and changes in this organisation are recorded here.
empty.filteredDescription: Try another search, or remove a filter.

export.capped: Stopped at {{cap}} events. Narrow the filters to export the rest.

band.dayLabel: {{n}} events in the last 24 hours, over time

chain.what: Each event carries the hash of the one before, so a changed or deleted event breaks the chain.

brokenNote.link: An event doesn't follow the one before it: one was deleted or reordered.
brokenNote.row: An event's contents changed after it was recorded.
brokenNote.other: An event doesn't match its hash.

chain.failed: Couldn't check the chain. Try again.

flagged.label: Flagged actions
flagged.emptyDescription: An admin action that's unusual for the person who did it shows here.

detection.title: Detection settings
detection.description: How unusual an admin action must be before it's flagged.
detection.enabledHint: Each action is scored against the person's own history: a first-time action adds 0.50, an unusual hour up to 0.30, a new address 0.20.
detection.thresholdHint: From 0 to 1. Higher flags fewer actions.
detection.baselineHint: Events a person needs before anything they do is flagged.
detection.baselineRange: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.

drawer.flaggedWhy: Flagged as unusual for this person: {{reasons}}.
drawer.byThisActor: By this actor, around the same time
drawer.relatedFailed: Couldn't load the events around it.
drawer.sameRequest_one: {{n}} other event shares its request ID.
drawer.sameRequest_other: {{n}} other events share its request ID.
drawer.noSameRequest: No other event shares its request ID.

sessions.title: Your sessions
sessions.description: Where you're signed in. Sign out of anything you don't recognise.

others.title: Other sessions
others.description: Each one is a browser or app still signed in as you.
others.empty: No other sessions are signed in as you.
others.confirmTitle: Sign out of all your other sessions?
others.confirmDescription: Every session except this one ends and can no longer be renewed, including any not listed here. A device that is signed in may keep access for a few more minutes, until its current access runs out. You stay signed in here.
others.none: There were no other sessions to sign out of
others.failed: Couldn't sign out your other sessions. Try again.

signOut.label: Sign out of {{device}}
signOut.title: Sign out of {{device}}?
signOut.description: Whoever is using it is signed out at once, and the session can't be renewed.

toast.rateLimitsResetTo: Rate limits are the platform's again

devices.title: Device sign-ins
devices.description: Sign-ins from devices without a browser.

auditLogs.title: View the audit log
auditLogs.subtitle: Browse and filter every change and sign-in

prompts.summarizeAnomalies: Summarise any unusual or high-risk events in the recent audit log.
prompts.failedLogins: Search the audit log for failed sign-ins in the last 24 hours.
prompts.adminActions: List the most recent administrative actions by everyone in this organisation.
